_about: PIX.MOV behavioral settings as data — pix-design v1.0.0. Values extracted from the Muse pix-2 client source (App.tsx, PixSection.tsx, PixPlayerKit.tsx, theme.css) unless a key is marked specSource.

brand.name: PIX.MOV
brand.nameRendering: Always full caps 'PIX.MOV'; in the header wordmark the '.' is a light bulb (see components.md).

palette.note: Locked 'Classic PIX' palette. Gold is deepened toward gold — darker than the live site's amber, still yellow, never orange.

header.heightNote: 62px + env(safe-area-inset-top); fixed; border-bottom 2px gold; solid black.

chaseBulbs.placement: Two runs (left/right) along the header's bottom edge, starting after the wordmark reserve and ending at the centered NOW PLAYING button; game-open adds a 10-bulb run.

responsiveDrops.note: left run hidden; right run shows 1 bulb

chaseBulbs.rule: Tighten, then drop bulbs — bulbs NEVER invade the logo's space (spec, handoff section 2.2).

nowPlayingButton.label: NOW PLAYING
nowPlayingButton.position: centered, straddling the header's bottom border

header.controlsShape: square — header buttons are square, never pills (spec, handoff section 2.1)
header.filmDnaIndicator: FILM DNA RECORDED X.XX% = rated films / films on record x 100 (spec, handoff section 2.2)
header.profilePicture: When set, the user's profile picture replaces the '...' account menu button (source: .account-trigger-avatar).

pool.rowSplit: pool split across the 3 rows round-robin (index % 3)
pool.specNote: SPEC (handoff section 2.3) calls for a 100-movie pool and the bottom (Movie vs Movie) row at about half the top row's speed; the shipped source fetches up to 60 and animates row 3 at 118s vs row 1's 48s. Files carry the source values; Brian's spec is recorded here so the difference is a decision, not a drift.

marquee.clickBehavior: Clicking a poster blooms a feature popup AT the click point (clamped inside the band): gold-bordered poster, dismiss x, title/year overlay on hover, MY SCREENING link, and a 'seen' button.
marquee.seenState: Seen films keep a green (#57d287) edge in the marquee.

genresButton.behavior: drop-down of every genre with a landing row; choosing one scrolls to that genre's row and unfolds it

channels.kind: Film CHANNEL rows (Horror, Recently Uploaded, genre:<slug> rows, custom list rows)

loop.engine: requestAnimationFrame; track renders the set 3 times and wraps by one set width (seamless, never empty)
loop.minSetNote: Sets with fewer than 8 posters repeat the real posters until the shelf has room to breathe.
loop.fullBleed: 100vw viewport; the row header stays in the page column

controls.visibility: fade in on viewport hover / focus-within; rest at opacity .55 on touch (pointer: coarse)
controls.clickBehavior: click sets the row's stream direction (last click wins; the live direction's button stays lit gold)
controls.holdBehavior: press-and-hold races the films that way at 560 px/s, overriding even pause, for as long as held

taglines._note: Only these two notes are literal in the client source (channelMeta fallbacks in App.tsx). Other rows' titles/notes arrive with the sections feed; genre rows are keyed genre:<slug>.

rowChrome.controlsPlacement: right-aligned at the right end of the tag line (spec + source)
rowChrome.foldChevron: '>' rotated 90deg when open; unrotated when folded
rowChrome.persistence: Row order + folded state persist per user (landing_layout: row_order + collapsed keys)

nowPlaying.presentation: floating overlay (fixed, below the 62px header) over a 78% black scrim
nowPlaying.frame: 2px gold border, solid black, expand animation .22s

hover.centerCheck: 44px green disc (#2e9d56, ring #baf0c8, white check) fades/scales in

nowPlaying.descriptions: hidden by default; float over the poster's bottom edge on hover / focus-within only

interestFold.trigger: [x] at the poster's OUTER top corner (left poster: top-left, right poster: top-right)
interestFold.effect: choosing records the answer and replaces that poster

nowPlaying.triageRule: ANY decision (seen, unseen, maybe, want to see, not interested, never heard of it) permanently removes the film from this user's NOW PLAYING rotation. Never resurface a decided film. (Hard product rule — spec, handoff section 2.4.)

fanType.directQuestionTrigger: after ~8 consecutive 'never seen' marks, ask one direct question

toughPix.button: solid gold (#f2b705), black text, 2px gold border, min-height 48px
toughPix.caption: Share PIX.MOV Challenge For Advice
toughPix.shareModel: unique #tough/<id> link; guest faces the exact matchup; sender sees share + pick counts in Profile

nowPlaying.newPairButton: Haven't watched it either (movies) / New pair — replaces both posters with no penalty

posterRules.displayScaleNote: SPEC (handoff section 2.5): posters and shorts display at 3/4 size with padding between them. Source expresses size per surface + the SIZER scale; no single 0.75 literal exists in source.
posterRules.hoverGrow: a few percent (1.02 in NOW PLAYING, 1.03 image zoom in Top 500) with a yellow/gold border (green #45b66b in NOW PLAYING)
posterRules.noPosterNoSlot: A matchup or row NEVER renders without a real poster; a film with no poster artwork simply does not occupy a slot. (Hard rule — spec, handoff section 2.5.)
posterRules.seenBorder: permanent green border (#57d287) on every film the user has marked seen, everywhere it appears

hoverTypes.name: Now Playing hover
hoverTypes.behavior: poster lifts, gold border, description floats over the poster

hoverTypes.name: Personal Rating hover
hoverTypes.behavior: fold-down panel: rating/verdict buttons, Move to List, Film page / Review / Discuss links

hoverTypes.name: Group by Mood hover
hoverTypes.behavior: card shows genre/mood grouping with a blue edge; mood tag tinted #9fdcff

want_to_watch.treatment: 3px gold outline, offset -3px (2px on poster stage)

maybe.treatment: 3px orange outline, offset -3px (2px on poster stage)

no_thanks.treatment: poster image brightness(.84) saturate(.92) — brightness .84 is the shipped equivalent of a ~16% black overlay (source comment)

top500.rankAndOptionsVisibility: hidden until poster hover/focus; always visible on touch
top500.posterClick: marks the film Seen/Watched — NEVER navigates

optionsFold.position: drops from the top-right of the card, green (#57d287) border, scaleY fold .18s

top500.seenHint: 30px green circle-check at the poster's top-left on hover; filled green once seen
top500.groups: collapsible hundreds — Top 100 open by default; 200-500 start minimized (spec, handoff section 2.6)

billboard.between: every ~2-minute segment of a classic film, and between Shorts
billboard.adPrecedence: a booked/managed ad takes the slot when one exists; otherwise the famous-quote billboard shows (source: Shorts break comment + player code)
billboard.quoteRotation: rotating through the built-in set below (Shorts: by position in the sequence; classic player: random start, then advances)
billboard.card: full-player gold card: BILLBOARD label, circular countdown numeral, quote in Georgia serif, attribution line, 'next in N seconds' line

player.capabilityGated: each control detects its own support and hides itself where the device/browser cannot do it

fallbacks.pip: standard requestPictureInPicture, else iOS Safari webkit presentation mode
fallbacks.fullscreen: container requestFullscreen, else iPhone webkitEnterFullscreen on the video
fallbacks.popOut: Document Picture-in-Picture window (Chromium); carries playback position out and back

player.buttonChrome: 44px square, top-right of the stage, translucent black with a white hairline border

filmPages.backButton: synopsis pages carry a Back button returning to the last visited page (spec, handoff section 2.8)
filmPages.addToList: + Add to list drop-down beside the synopsis; lists only the viewer's own (creation lives in the Profile only)

seenArchive.entry: poster-sized black tile with yellow trim
seenArchive.grid: 4-wide year cards, 2026 back to 1895, real film counts
seenArchive.drilldown: year card -> that year's full poster grid -> film pages

footer.copyrightNote: 2029 as written in the Muse build (App.tsx footer) — flagged to Brian as a possible typo, unconfirmed; ship as written, do not silently change.
elements: gold Feedback button (feedback / ideas / issues / report user)

biscuit.role: PIX.MOV's single consent gate / cookie & data launcher
biscuit.presentsWhen: first visit while the saved decision is 'pending'; re-opens on the 'pix:open-consent' event (footer/profile/legal 'Cookie & Data Consent' links, game consent blocks)
biscuit.declineEffect: profile switches to anonymous: no game choices saved, no FILM DNA, no ad measurement; picks still move the game forward, unrecorded
biscuit.panel: bottom-sheet on small screens / centered from 980px up; width min(680px, 100%); gold border with a 6px gold top rule

genres.menuContents: every genre with a row on the landing page (Drama, Comedy, Thriller, Documentary, Horror, Sci-Fi, ... — all we have)
